# BRAIN API response samples

These are not generated by `generate_fixtures.py` and must not be edited by hand.

They are BRAIN's own sample responses, taken on 2026-11-02 from the public web app bundle at
platform.worldquantbrain.com. The editor walkthrough mocks the API with them (lazy chunks
5378, 8114, 1207, 3088 and 6480, each a `JSON.parse('...')` module). Each file is the
parsed JSON written out compactly.

| File | Endpoint it mocks |
|---|---|
| simulation.json | GET /simulations/<id> (finished) |
| alpha.json | GET /alphas/<id> |
| recordsets.json | GET /alphas/<id>/recordsets |
| yearly_stats.json | GET /alphas/<id>/recordsets/yearly-stats |
| pnl.json | GET /alphas/<id>/recordsets/pnl (cumulative) |

They show the response shape. They are not a capture from our account, so values such as
check limits are BRAIN's example values, not ours.
